scenes.text: On July 20th, 1969, the front pages all said the same thing.
Men had walked on the Moon, and a quarter of humanity watched it live.
It's still the only time people have walked on another world.

props.headline: Men walk on the Moon as millions watch live
props.body: Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Edwin Aldrin stepped onto the lunar surface last night, while Michael Collins orbited above in the command module.
props.whyItMatters: Five more crewed landings followed. None since 1972.
